Module com.example.fortune_cookies_app
Package com.example.fortune_cookies_app.model

Class AIMessageDAO

java.lang.Object
com.example.fortune_cookies_app.model.AbstractDAO
com.example.fortune_cookies_app.model.AIMessageDAO
public class AIMessageDAO extends AbstractDAO
The AIMessageDAO class is responsible for managing the persistence of AIMessage objects in a database. It provides methods to save, delete, and retrieve AI messages. The class also ensures that the necessary database table is created if it does not already exist upon initialization.

    • saveMessage

      public void saveMessage(AIMessage message)
      Saves the provided AIMessage to the database. The method first checks if the message already exists in the database using the checkMessage method. If the message is not already present, it inserts the message into the messages table and assigns a generated ID to the message.
      Parameters:
      message - The AIMessage object containing the user ID and message content to be saved in the database.

    • fetchMessages

      public List<AIMessage> fetchMessages(User user)
      Fetches all messages associated with the specified user from the database.
      Parameters:
      user - The user whose messages are to be retrieved. The user's ID is used to query the database for the messages.
      Returns:
      A list of AIMessage objects associated with the given user. If no messages are found, an empty list is returned.

    • checkMessage

      public boolean checkMessage(AIMessage message)
      Checks if a given message exists in the database for a specific user.
      Parameters:
      message - The AIMessage object containing the user ID and message content to be checked in the database.
      Returns:
      true if the message exists in the database, false otherwise.
